description: Growth skills for ecommerce brands by gocrux.io, best with a Crux Growth Brain connected: planning and targets, performance reporting and diagnosis, and conversion.

interface.shortDescription: Crux growth skills: planning, performance reporting and diagnosis, and conversion
interface.longDescription: Growth skills written by operators who have scaled ecommerce brands. Plan peaks and targets against your own history, report on and diagnose performance across trading, acquisition, retention and product, and find what to fix on your landing pages. Each skill runs on your own data and ends on what to do next.
defaultPrompt: Which of my landing pages are underperforming?
Why did my revenue drop last month?
How did last month go? Write my monthly review.
